description: Procure-to-pay as Portal and BC run it (BC transaction mapping brief, P2P; Vince's Packaging Procure-to-GL Map stages 11, 13, 16, 17 and 19): purchase order, supplier confirmation (document-derived, optional), warehouse receipt(s) (BC purchase receipt, receive-only), vendor invoice posted in BC, and its G/L entries. Three-way match is the quantity check below: PO line vs receipt quantity, receipt vs invoice quantity, PO vs invoice unit price. Payment is the last stage: BC marks a posted invoice Paid once payments and applied credit memos settle it (posted vendor payments and vendor ledger entries are not captured; vendor payment journal lines are captured as pending Payment objects, never proof of a payment: devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-07-bc-finance-2-payment-ledger.md); a credit memo applied to the PO's invoices is the optional vendor_credit stage.

stages.label: Purchase order
stages.description: The PO is issued by the shared purchase-order status definition (operating.po_status: a gold or BC draft is not issued, a cancelled PO is not live, an unmapped word is unknown), or an FM or Sage purchase order record.

evidence.note: BC API v2.0 purchaseOrder status (captured: integrations/bc_purchase.py SELECT) read by the shared definition: Draft is a PO not yet released, so not issued, as a gold DRAFT is not (lane process-deps-decisions, directive 40cbdb929c97); an unreadable status leaves the stage unknown, never issued.

FileMaker generated_purchase_order header read by the shared definition (operating.po_status), never by existence: DRAFT is not issued, Cancel is ignored, an unmapped or null word leaves the stage unknown. Legacy only for FileMaker: since staging 38cd3f3 Generate PO writes app_purchase_order and no generated_purchase_order (359e2f0 TASK-2651).
Sage PO header: its existence evidences the PO (Sage iscomplete is not mapped by the shared definition).

stages.label: Supplier confirmation
stages.description: The supplier confirmed the PO (order confirmation / proforma invoice). Portal and BC record none (runner.ts po.sent_unconfirmed_3d; map stage 13: vendor confirmation and PI number are Missing), so the evidence is a document-derived SupplierConfirmation read from captured mail attachments and SharePoint files (ontology/document_fields.py) and linked to the PO it names. Such a link is a lead: reported in the stage's gap, never counted as present; a reviewed link counts. Optional: receiving never waits on it.

evidence.note: Document-field links (SupplierConfirmation.confirms, ontology/document_fields.py store_document_links) and recorded reviews; a machine-read reference alone is a lead, never evidence.

stages.source_note: plx-customer-portal:portal/src/lib/work-routing/runner.ts@c3ffda3 (po.sent_unconfirmed_3d: "The portal records no vendor confirmation and no sent-at"); operating/process_stage_map.json stage 13.

stages.label: Receipt
stages.description: Goods were received against the PO (a receipt record of the PO; of its verified twin only when the PO's own system holds none, as the received side reads it).

evidence.note: Since staging 38cd3f3 a packaging receipt is a portal app_receipt (PO_RECEIPT, receipt_number = the RP lab id, PO by exact po_number) with its line and quarantine lot, never a FileMaker receiptpack row (5cade1b TASK-2652); raw receipts are still FileMaker rows copied by upsertGoldReceipt.

stages.label: Vendor invoice
stages.description: A BC purchase invoice for the PO (or, only when the PO's own system holds none, for its verified BC twin, or naming the PO's number as the Portal matches invoices: PurchaseInvoice.names_order, counted only when one company's records name it) exists and is not a draft or cancelled.

stages.label: G/L posting
stages.description: The vendor invoice reached the general ledger (G/L entries with its document number).

stages.label: Vendor credit
stages.description: A posted BC purchase credit memo is applied to an invoice of the PO (PurchaseCreditMemo.applies_to: invoiceId, else a number naming one invoice of the same company). Its amount is netted by its document type, never its sign. A memo naming no invoice reaches no PO and is never netted into one; it is reached from its vendor (PurchaseCreditMemo.credited_by). Optional: most invoices are never credited, so it never positions current_stage.

stages.label: Vendor payment
stages.description: Every posted, live BC purchase invoice of the PO (or, only when the PO's own system holds none, of its verified BC twin) is Paid: settled by payments and applied credit memos. An Open invoice is not paid; how much is still owed is its remaining_amount (plx.aggregate, per currency), a gap where BC serves none.

evidence.note: BC API v2.0 purchaseInvoice status: Draft and In Review are not posted, Canceled and Corrective were reversed by a corrective credit memo; Open is posted and not settled, Paid is settled (plx-customer-portal@790256c portal/src/lib/business-central/inbound.ts projectPurchaseInvoice: status=Paid is authoritative)

quantity_checks.description: Per item (records joined only by verified/reviewed Product.same_record_as): ordered vs received quantity (one-sided, as Portal), received vs invoiced quantity, PO unit price vs invoice unit cost. Each side's quantities come from one system of record: the PO's own records, or its twin's only when the PO's own system has none (never summed together). Several receipts of one PO are summed; a Sage receipt that may cover several POs is cited, never attributed. Draft and cancelled invoices do not count. Units and currencies must agree; nothing is converted.
